Namaste! Batch 2 mein hum CCS Leave Travel Concession Rules 1988 ke Rules 7 se 11 dekhenge: admissibility, leave, LTC ke types, block years, counting aur carry-over. Rule 7 sub rule 1 ke mutabiq, specified civil service aur contract categories ke liye employee ki ek saal ki continuous Central Government service journey ki date par poori honi chahiye. Ye test employee ya family member, dono ki journey ki date par lagta hai. Doosri categories ke liye Rule 2 bhi dekhein. Ye video study material hai, legal advice nahi. Claim ke liye latest applicable official orders verify karein.

Rule 7 sub rule 2 ke mutabiq LTC kisi bhi type ki leave ke dauraan admissible hai, including casual leave aur special casual leave. Guidelines child care leave aur study leave ka bhi zikr karti hain. Sirf weekend ya holiday par, bina leave ke, employee ki LTC admissible nahi hai. Lekin agar sirf eligible family travel kar rahi ho aur employee nahi, to FAQ ke mutabiq employee ko leave lene ki zaroorat nahi. Vacation department ke employees ke liye vacation ko regular leave maana jaata hai. Study leave ke fare aur particular conditions ke liye relevant original order verify karein.

Rule 7 ke practical notes yaad rakhein. Railway accommodation ki class journey ke samay ki normal entitlement se tay hoti hai. Journey se pehle Controlling Officer ko inform karein aur journey ke baad proof dein. Service record mein LTC availment ki entry honi chahiye. Technical resignation par guidelines continuity aur appointment ke aath saal ke andar fresh recruit treatment ka zikr karti hain. Iske liye seventeen August 2016 ka relevant order aur applicable conditions check karein. Agar declared hometown India ke bahar hai aur Controlling Officer satisfy ho, to guideline limited Government assistance ki baat karti hai. Exact limit ke liye original applicable order verify karein; yahan formula assume nahi kiya gaya.

Rule 8 mein LTC ke types hain. Hometown LTC do calendar years ke block mein ek baar milti hai. Any place in India LTC chaar calendar years ke block mein ek baar milti hai. Jis employee ko hometown LTC admissible hai, any place LTC us hometown concession ke badle mein aur uske against adjust hoti hai jo journey shuru hone ke samay available thi. Is proviso aur Rule 10 carry-forward ke combination ka official worked example supplied sources mein nahi hai, isliye case-specific clarification lein. Agar family hometown par rehti hai, Rule 8 clause c ke under employee specified conditions par baaki concessions ke badle har saal sirf apne liye hometown LTC choose kar sakta hai.

Block year samajhiye. FAQ ki table mein chaar calendar years ka block 2026 se 2029 diya hai. Hometown entitlement wale employee ke do sub-blocks 2026 se 2027 aur 2028 se 2029 bante hain. Ye 28 October 2026 ki date ke liye FAQ table se nikala gaya hai; ise alag 2026 order ka direct quote na samjhein. Headquarters aur hometown alag hon, to applicable conditions ke saath ek sub-block mein hometown aur doosre mein any place choose kiya ja sakta hai. FAQ aur Rule 10 unavailed concession ko agle block ke pehle saal tak carry karne ki conditions batate hain.

Agar headquarters aur hometown same place hain, to hometown LTC admissible nahi hoti; FAQ ke mutabiq four year block mein any place in India LTC milti hai. Delhi ke headquarters ke liye doosre NCR states ke cities ko Delhi nahi maana jaata; FAQ question 20 ki conditions check karein. Carry-over ke saath ek calendar year mein do LTC possible ho sakti hain. FAQ question 16 mein 2026 ka example hai: eligible unavailed concession of 2024 to 2025 aur current 2026 to 2027 concession. Headquarters aur hometown same hone par FAQ question 17 mein previous aur new four year blocks ka separate example hai. Har example ki individual conditions check karein.

Rule 9: employee aur eligible family alag groups aur alag times par travel kar sakte hain. Concession us block mein count hoti hai jisme outward journey shuru hoti hai, chahe return block ke baad ho. Rule 10: unavailed LTC ko applicable conditions par next block ke first year mein carry forward kiya ja sakta hai. Hometown entitlement wale employee ki any place carry-forward par Rule 10 ka second sentence, second two year block ki hometown concession se link batata hai. Supplied sources mein iska official worked example nahi hai, isliye original wording aur competent authority ki clarification lein. Rule 11 ke mutabiq employee aur family members alag places visit kar sakte hain, applicable declaration aur conditions ke saath.

Ab examples. Agar outward journey 28 December 2027 ko shuru ho aur return 4 January 2028 ko ho, to Rule 9 ke mutabiq counting outward journey ke block mein hogi. Agar eligible hometown concession 2026 se 2027 mein unavailed rahi, to applicable Rule 10 conditions ke saath use next sub-block ke first year 2028 mein liya ja sakta hai. Agar posting aur hometown Pune dono hon, hometown LTC nahi, lekin applicable any place concession dekhein. Agar employee ne 15 March 2026 ko join kiya aur family 20 December 2026 ko travel kare, to one year journey-date test poora nahi hota. Har scenario mein category, applicable orders aur complete facts verify karein.

Ab quick recap. Rule 7 mein journey ki date par continuous service ki condition aur admissible leave check karein. Sirf family travel kare to employee ko leave ki zaroorat nahi. Rule 8 mein hometown, any place aur annual self visit ka option hai, har ek ki apni conditions ke saath. FAQ ka 2026 se 2029 block aur uske sub-blocks example ke roop mein dekhein. Rule 9 outward journey se counting tay karta hai. Rule 10 carry-forward ki conditions deta hai. Rule 11 alag places ka option batata hai. Fresh recruit rules aur special categories ko is batch ka complete treatment na samjhein; attachment unhe agle batch ke liye rakhta hai.

Practice questions. Rule 7 ka one year test kis date par dekha jaata hai? Journey ki date par. Sirf family travel kare to kya employee ko leave leni hoti hai? FAQ ke mutabiq nahi. Hometown LTC ka normal block kitna hai? Do calendar years. Any place LTC ka normal block kitna hai? Chaar calendar years. LTC ki counting outward ya return journey se hoti hai? Outward journey se. Unavailed LTC ki carry-forward window? Applicable conditions ke saath next block ka pehla saal. Jahan Rule 8 aur Rule 10 ka combination unclear ho, original order aur written clarification lein.
